purpose: Resolve failure modes observed in Sprint 3 without modifying its frozen protocol or artifacts.

estimand.target: CATE of conversion on Criteo v2.1

problem_to_intervention.problem: rare conversion and few control positives
problem_to_intervention.evidence: conversion rate 0.2917%; development control has 1625 positives
problem_to_intervention.intervention: funnel factorization through visit as auxiliary training outcome
problem_to_intervention.leakage_guard: visit is never an input to predict; scoring uses f0..f11 only

problem_to_intervention.problem: sentinel-like point masses and only 53 observed structural patterns
problem_to_intervention.evidence: 6/12 features have mode_share > 0.9; sentinel-pattern effect heterogeneity is significant
problem_to_intervention.intervention: fold-local sentinel flags plus sentinel count
problem_to_intervention.leakage_guard: mode values are fit from X_train of each OOF fold without treatment or outcome

problem_to_intervention.problem: prognostic dominance makes Response hard to beat
problem_to_intervention.intervention: retain Response as mandatory reference; only promote on policy_area_dr across both fold seeds

problem_to_intervention.evidence: three challengers beat Response by Qini but not by policy_area_dr/AUTOC
problem_to_intervention.intervention: keep policy_area_dr primary and report Qini only as secondary

metrics.inference: paired bootstrap on the same OOF rows

selection_rule.screening: candidate must be finite/nonconstant and evaluated on at least 200 control conversions
selection_rule.advance: policy_area_dr greater than Response on both fold seeds
selection_rule.promotion: requires a new randomized confirmation campaign; retrospective Sprint 2 confirmation cannot promote this iteration

candidates.name: Response-Sentinel
candidates.hypothesis: explicit fold-local point-mass flags make structural patterns easier for trees

candidates.name: S-Under7
candidates.hypothesis: best simple CATE reference from Sprint 3

candidates.name: S-Sentinel-Under7
candidates.hypothesis: sentinel flags expose the strongest observed structural moderator

candidates.name: Funnel-S
candidates.hypothesis: higher-prevalence visit auxiliary outcome reduces rare-conversion estimation noise

candidates.name: Funnel-S-Sentinel
candidates.hypothesis: combine funnel factorization with fold-local structural flags
